summary_hint: employer, employee, tax year, Box 1 wages

typed_core.name: tax_year
typed_core.why: IN-11 (2-year history), IN-6, IN-10 — the year is the join key

typed_core.name: employer_ein
typed_core.why: IN-5 disambiguator — two employers with similar names; also PII

typed_core.name: employee_ssn
typed_core.prompt_hint: NEVER place an SSN in additional_sections — catch-all values are stored unmasked

typed_core.name: wages_tips_other_comp
typed_core.why: IN-1, IN-3, IN-10, IN-11 — Box 1, the qualifying figure
typed_core.prompt_hint: Read BOX 1 — not Boxes 3 or 5, which differ with pre-tax deferrals

typed_core.name: social_security_wages
typed_core.why: Box 3 disambiguator — differs from Box 1 when there are pre-tax deferrals

typed_core.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
typed_core.why: Box 2 — processor reference, and FR-1 reconciliation context

typed_core.name: retirement_plan_checked
typed_core.why: Box 13 — AS-4 may need a retirement-plan signal

typed_core.name: statutory_employee_checked
typed_core.why: Box 13 — IN-12 distinguishes self-employed borrowers; a statutory employee is the hybrid case
typed_core.prompt_hint: Box 13 has three checkboxes — capture statutory employee and retirement plan separately

typed_core.name: is_corrected_w2
typed_core.why: disambiguator — a W-2c SUPERSEDES the original. Without it, two W-2s for one tax year look like a contradiction to IN-11 and IN-6
typed_core.prompt_hint: If the form is a W-2c, set this and read the CORRECTED amounts

rejected.name: Box 12 codes
rejected.reason: variable, and no rule reads them; catch-all

rejected.name: income_qualifies_for_underwriting
rejected.reason: a judgment, not a fact — IN-1's job. Tags describe; rules judge

encoding_variations: Box numbers are federally fixed — the most standardised document in the set
Layout varies (4-up perforated, single, employer-printed) but labels are constant
A corrected W-2 is titled 'W-2c' with different box labelling

open_questions.q: retirement_plan_checked and statutory_employee_checked are booleans, but there is no coerce_bool
open_questions.recommendation: str for now — the same degradation applies across dozens of indicator fields; adding coerce_bool is a separate, global decision

open_questions.q: is_corrected_w2 is a rule-floor INFERENCE, not an explicit requirement
open_questions.recommendation: include — no rule names it, but IN-11 and IN-6 would misbehave with a W-2c and its original present together

notes: The most standardised document in the set — federally fixed box numbers make encoding variation minimal.
The shipping extractor covers most of this; the spec adds 4 fields.
